g.text: iaddr_q: image word index; row = iaddr_q[6:2], word in row = 3 - iaddr_q[1:0]
rcnt_q: image READs left before the WRITE phase
(20 = rows 0-4, then 8, or 4 for the last pooled row)
wi_q: WRITE index; wi_q[2:0] = kernel, wi_q[3] = 0 for columns 8-14 + pad, 1 for columns 0-7
st_cnt_q: staging words written in this pooled row (cleared with the 16th WRITE)
register (D flip-flops on clk rising edge)
name = net label (same name, same net)
